correctness.rationale: PASS: Discriminant −16(4(t²+1)^3+27) has six simple finite roots, and local minimal form at infinity has c4,Δ orders (2,6), giving I0* and D4 root lattice. Rational ancestor χ=1, ρ=10, and Shioda–Tate rank=10−2−4=4; torsion precluded by positive minimal height. Its Mordell–Weil lattice is D4* from standard rational elliptic-surface classification. Degree-two base change, ramified at infinity and away from six nodes, removes I0*, leaves twelve I1 and χ(X)=1, scaling inherited height by 2. Hence 24 unit minimum vectors in D4*, with intersection P·Q=1−2〈v,w〉. Independent exact rational vector enumeration verified all 24 and every 8/6/8/1 incidence multiset; exact discriminant derivatives also checked. No assertion of full base-changed MW rank.
